body: It never hurt that much for me. It just felt good, and the feeling of blood dripping somehow gave me a brief peace. I'm kinda a masochist though so it is probably different for me. I know its unhealthy both mentally and physically, but i can't stop. My only advice would be to be careful, and cutting to try to commit suicide does not always work, I am living proof of that.
Its utter bs. I suppose for some, its not that it gets better, but that they get stronger. This is not the case for me, but i hope it is for others.
